result.prompt: Use generate_image to create a soft painterly landscape of a peaceful alpine lake at sunrise, in a fixed 16:9 horizontal composition. With no source image, establish an original scene: glassy water fills the lower half, a distant shoreline crosses just below center, and a rugged mountain range rises across the upper half, its tallest peak slightly right of center. View from the near shore at standing eye height, looking straight across the lake with a level horizon; place a few smooth slate-gray stones and fine tawny grasses in the lower-left foreground. Thin, translucent mist drifts in horizontal ribbons over the water, gently obscuring reflections without hiding them. Low sunlight enters from the left, bathing the upper peaks in warm peach, apricot, and pale gold, while mountain recesses remain muted lavender and blue-gray. The sky grades from soft coral near the horizon to dusty pale blue overhead. Render rock faces, sparse dark evergreen slopes, and still water with delicate layered brushwork, softened edges, and subtle canvas texture; retain enough detail to distinguish stone, trees, and vapor. Keep the lighting diffuse and serene, with no harsh contrast. No people, buildings, boats, lettering, or logos; preserve the tranquil setting and uncluttered framing. Review the completed still before using it as a video reference.
